title: Train-Only-Constrained LM for Synthetic Clinical Trajectories: Leak-Safe Calibration and Auditable Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2611.34258v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Simulating clinical time series necessitates temporal realism, calibration that preserves model integrity, and privacy transparency. We present a train-only, constrained language-model pipeline that factorizes generation. A compact GPT-style language model learns cross-biomarker co-occurrence through quantile tokens, and temporal directions are enforced by 3x3 per-biomarker Markov transitions fit on TRAIN, allowing dynamics to be audited. We fit a monotone quantile map (QMap) on TRAIN only (SYN(TRAIN) -> SIM(TRAIN)); no TEST statistics are used. The fixed map is then applied to SYN(TEST) severities. The constrained LM demonstrated improved distributional fidelity and co-occurrence in a 5,000-patient simulated testbed (parameters within published clinical ranges) compared to an empirical sampler, maintained near-chance detectability after a small lambda-sweep, and exhibits temporal adherence by construction. translated_title: 面向合成临床轨迹的仅训练集约束语言模型：防泄漏校准与可审计动力学
translated_abstract: 模拟临床时间序列需要时间真实性、保持模型完整性的校准以及隐私透明度。我们提出了一种仅使用训练集的、受约束的语言模型流水线，对生成过程进行因式分解。一个紧凑的GPT风格语言模型通过分位数标记学习跨生物标志物的共现关系，而时间方向则由仅在训练集（TRAIN）上拟合的每个生物标志物3x3马尔可夫转移矩阵来强制执行，从而使动力学可被审计。我们仅在训练集上拟合单调分位数映射（QMap）（SYN(TRAIN) -> SIM(TRAIN)）；不使用任何测试集（TEST）统计量，随后将该固定映射应用于SYN(TEST)的严重程度。在一个5,000名患者的模拟测试平台（参数均处于已发表的临床范围内）中，与经验采样器相比，该受约束语言模型展现出更高的分布保真度和共现准确性，在小型lambda扫描后保持接近随机的可检测性，并通过构造保证了时间一致性。基于分类器的成员推断……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种仅用训练集校准的约束式语言模型流水线，通过分位数标记学习共现关系并用可审计的马尔可夫转移矩阵约束时间动态，在防泄漏（不使用测试集统计量）的前提下生成了分布保真度更高、隐私可检测性接近随机的合成临床轨迹。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a train-only-constrained language-model pipeline that combines quantile-token co-occurrence learning with auditable per-biomarker Markov transitions and leak-safe TRAIN-only quantile calibration, producing synthetic clinical trajectories with improved distributional fidelity and near-chance membership detectability.
